terra.problem: The passage says a shoot and Branch will come from Jesse’s stump and roots. It does not say Jesse himself gets a fresh start.
The Branch delights in the fear of the LORD. Saying He is glad to be right where He is adds an unstated feeling.
Papa Dorin was put in the junk drawer. Saying he hid there changes his backstory.
The group-chat joke puts the Branch into a modern phone scenario. Papa Dorin’s comparisons should stay on the human side.
The passage does not say the poor have nothing to give Him or that this is why they might be skipped over.
The verse names the rod of His mouth. Saying no weapon is mentioned and only His mouth is named obscures that image.
The text says the rod is *of* His mouth, not that the rod is His mouth. It also does not say nothing needs to be carried.
The text leaves the scope of ‘them’ open. It does not clearly say that the child leads the leopard.
The awkward-conversation joke has no clear action or punchline. It is hard to tell who would be having the conversation or why.
The verse says ‘they’ will neither harm nor destroy. Changing that to ‘nobody’ makes the statement broader than the text.
Saying ‘I deal with bills too’ invents an unestablished part of Papa Dorin’s life and implies the individual baker deals with bills.
‘Every drop of that sea is covered’ is confusing rather than explanatory. The sea is the comparison for how full the earth will be.
The angel callback lacks the backstory needed to place it, such as the angel calling Papa Dorin out of the drawer.
‘Nobody is too far’ broadens the promise beyond the scattered of Judah whom the passage says the Lord will collect.
‘Envy sticks around in most families’ is a family stereotype.
‘A road is being made’ presents the highway as already underway. Isaiah says there will be a highway.
Genesis 11:31 supports the journey from Ur, but it does not state that Abram was later called Abraham. The identity needs a verse that states it, such as Genesis 17:5.
The speaker praises the LORD, but the explanation states gratitude as the speaker’s feeling rather than marking it as Papa Dorin’s reading.
Papa Dorin was placed in the junk drawer; he did not hide there.
